items.briefing:
The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has issued a warning about critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway — products used by many organisations to manage secure network access. If your organisation uses these products, IT teams should apply patches immediately, as attackers can exploit these flaws to gain unauthorised access to systems. Additionally, with Australian privacy law reforms on the horizon, organisations should begin reviewing how they collect and handle personal data now, rather than scrambling once new legislation passes.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT team today whether your organisation uses Citrix NetScaler products and confirm that security updates have been applied.
